confidence_notes: I ran three web searches. One was for the RBA rate. Two were for Matsuyama prices: a general cost-of-living search (Livingcost, Nomad Watch, CityCost, Numbeo snippets) and a search for bar prices. The cost-of-living sources were crowdsourced and disagreed widely. For example, inexpensive meals ranged from about $1.35 to $8, and cappuccino from about $2.9 to $4. I settled on bounded mid-values for beer, coffee and meals. I found no direct price for cocktails or wine by the glass in Matsuyama, so I set those from a typical Japanese price relationship to restaurant draft beer, with cocktails and wine slightly above beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of regional Japanese cities and were not checked against any listings. Dorm and private hostel prices are the least certain because hostel supply in Matsuyama is thin. A USD/JPY rate of roughly 150 to 155 was assumed for converting local price levels.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a mid-sized regional Japanese city (Shikoku) with a tourism draw from Dogo Onsen and Matsuyama Castle. Prices are below Tokyo, Osaka and Kyoto and comparable to cities like Okayama, Kumamoto and Takamatsu.
